iLock_Geography
Package iLock_Geography :: Package predicate_library :: Module position
[frames] | no frames]

Module position

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to positions of objects.

Classes
  SamePosition
Predicate class that builds true point '(obj_1, obj_2)' if both obj_1 and obj_2 of type INSIDE_TYPE_C are co-located within a node.
  NextObject
Predicate class that builds true point '(source, dest)' if dest is the qualified next object of source.

Imports: alg, GeoPredicate, INSIDE_TYPE_C, geoAssert, stringIterable2set
